block.minecells.return_stone.title: Return to The Undergarden
item.minecells.dimensional_rune.tooltip:
Use on a Doorway in The Undergarden
to change its destination
item.minecells.dimensional_rune.only_usa: You can only use this rune in The Undergarden
book.minecells.entries.dimensions.overwo: The main hub, where your Mine Cells journey begins. Strange door-like portals have appeared throughout The Undergarden; it may be worth investigating their destinations...
book.minecells.entries.items.doorway.des:
Doorways are the primary method of accessing the dimensions of Mine Cells.

Doorways to Prisoners' Quarters can be found in The Undergarden, and can be broken, crafted, and placed elsewhere.
book.minecells.entries.items.doorway.dim:
Dimensional Runes can be used to change the destination of a Doorway in The Undergarden.
They're granted when you first enter a Mine Cells dimension, but can also be crafted.

You can only use it if you've already visited the rune's dimension through a Doorway with the same coordinates as the one you want to change.
